title: UG-007 — How to configure number quiz questions
intent: Explain how to configure scoring rules for numerical quiz answers.
short_answer: Number quiz questions support numerical comparison rules. In addition to equal to and empty, you can use operators such as less than, less than or equal to, greater than, greater than or equal to, and between.
important_conditions: Use “between” when an accepted numerical range should be scored as correct.
